development_pipeline.description: Employee IDs of development pipeline candidates (not yet ready but identified for future development).

succession_depth.description: Healthy = 2+ credible successors incl 1 Ready; Limited = 1 ready/near-ready; At Risk = no Ready successor; Vacant/Critical = no credible successor.

successor_basis.description: Provenance of the current successor slots, e.g. 'History-derived' when populated from recorded appointment history. Cleared once HR confirms or replaces the entries.

successor_evidence.description: Recorded-history basis for the current successor slots (feeder appointment, observed moves and share of arrivals) — retained for HR review.
